pages.title: Stellar Frame Casing
pages.text: A casing of neutronium plate over event horizon casing with a Higgs field capacitor to steady its mass. It is built to hold the weight and heat of a star, and it glows faintly gold at the seams. Standing beside it feels like standing near a hearth.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Stellar machines put their housings under both gravity and heat. Event horizon casing kept the energy in, neutronium plate kept the shape, and a Higgs capacitor let me adjust the mass of the casing itself.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Stellar Lamp.
